blocks.text: The Resources page gives insight into your organization's configured object data. It allows you to monitor and analyze the data for all configured agents and AppZones in your organization.
The Resources page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a summary of resource data in your organization.
View, monitor, and analyze resource data for a single workload.
Take appropriate actions based on the resource data displayed.
Discover insights about collective resource data.

blocks.text: On the Resources page (Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Resources VM), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Refresh the Resources page to reflect the most current information.
Show or hide available columns.
Show or hide available filters.

Filter the information. Click the + icon to view additional filters. After configuring your preferred filters, click the button to apply the filters (e.g., Apply 1 filter, Apply 2 filters) and view the results.
See image.
View a list of all resources that are configured for your organization. For each resource, you can see:
Name: The name of the resource.
AppZone: The name of the AppZone connected to the resource.
Type: The type of resource.
Cloud: The cloud name where the resource resides.
Status: The status of the resource.
Platform: The operating system where the resource resides.
Last Seen: The last time the resource connected.
Click an individual resource to view its complete information:
Click Resource Details to see General Information and Environment data.
